claims.statement: For an indefinite physical 2x2 pivot block B=[[a,c],[c,-b]] with a,b>=m>0 and Delta=ab+c^2, if the exact Schur critical value kappa has concentration P(|kappa-t|<=r)<=L sqrt(r) for r<=1, then the full quadratic form has ||p||_infinity<=4 Delta^(-1/4)m^(-1/4)max(1,sqrt(L)).
In the live fleet03/B19 one-effective residue, any exact Schur diagonal |S_ii|>=9/1120 yields ||p_Q||_infinity<25 for all admissible product laws.
In the same residue, if all |S_ii|<9/1120 then some disjoint original-coordinate cut I,J satisfies s_1(S[I,J])>27/2240.

If the live exact Schur complement has S=D+mu w w^T for the previous diffuse outside vector max w_i^2<7/27, the full quadratic-form density is universally bounded; the displayed constants give ||p_Q||_infinity<36.

After excluding the paid Schur-diagonal, ridge-certified and exact diffuse-rank-one endpoints, force either a second independent cross/ridge direction or perturbative reduction to a diffuse rank-one-plus-diagonal Schur form.
